annotations.title: Group trip cost splitter: yacht charter, villa and private jet

description: Divides one total between up to 12 parties: equally per person, equally per party, by person-nights, or by room weighting × nights (e.g. 1.5 for a master suite). Shares are whole cents (largest-remainder method) and add up exactly to the total. With amounts already paid, returns each party’s balance (paid − share) and settle-up transfers; anything unpaid is owed to the suppliers (to: null). Lists are comma-separated, one value per party, in the same order. The page supports several costs with a method each; this API takes one total. No sourced facts: all figures are the caller’s. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/group-trip-cost-splitter

currency.description: Currency of the amounts (labels only; nothing is converted).

method.description: How to split: person (equally per person), party (equally per party), night (by person-nights), room (by room weighting × nights).

nights.description: Nights (or days) each party is present, comma-separated (default 7 for every party). Used by the night and room methods.

paid.description: Amount each party has already paid, comma-separated (default 0).

partySizes.description: People in each party, comma-separated, e.g. "2,2,4" (1–50 each, up to 12 parties).

roomWeights.description: Cabin or room weighting per party, comma-separated (default 1; e.g. 1.5 for a master suite). Used by the room method.

total.description: The shared cost to split, e.g. the charter fee.

name: group-trip-cost-splitter
